extDescription.message: Sends your Path of Exile session cookie to the Xiletrade app in one click, no copy and paste.

hint.message: Log in on the trade site, then send your session cookie to Xiletrade. The app must be installed.

sent.message: Sent : accept the opening of Xiletrade if your browser asks.

allow.message: Allow access to the trade sites

needAccess.message: Access to the trade sites is needed to read the session cookie.

privacy.message: Nothing is stored or sent online : the session cookie only goes to the app on this computer.
